name: Kasou Kowloon kara no Dasshuu
source:
The main character, Tsubaki, who woke up in a strange place, had lost his memory from leaving the house to waking up here. Meanwhile, unfortunately, the place where he was entangled in a thug is helped by his brother and sister who call themselves "Asagi" and "Hanada". The two who understood the situation promised to cooperate in order for Tsubaki to escape from this "virtual Kowloon".

Why did Tsubaki come to the virtual Kowloon? What is the true identity of Asagi and others who are willing to cooperate with strangers, and what is "Virtual Kowloon"? When everything crosses, the story overflows with pieces of truth.

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/27662]Freem![/url]]
translation:
主角椿在陌生的地方醒来，从离开家到在这里苏醒之间的记忆完全消失了。不幸遭到暴徒纠缠时，一对自称“浅葱”与“缥”的兄妹救下了椿。了解情况后，两人答应协助椿逃离这座“虚拟九龙”。

椿为什么会来到虚拟九龙？毫不吝惜地帮助陌生人的浅葱兄妹，究竟是什么身份？“虚拟九龙”又是什么？当一切交错之时，故事将流露出真相的碎片。
